prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in Pasadena, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right and center lanes of the roadway with visible contact damage to the right rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the left front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that Vehicle 2 attempted to change lanes from the center lane into the lane occupied by Vehicle 1 without signaling, and that contact occurred along the side of the vehicle. Driver 2 stated that Vehicle 1 was partially in the blind spot and that the driver attempted to move back into the original lane. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 was present and was not injured. Driver 1 reported a headache and dizziness and stated that they had struck their head on the window frame; they were evaluated by EMS on scene and transported for further medical assessment. Driver 1 was later noted to be experiencing symptoms consistent with a concussion, per EMS. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Both vehicles were driven from the scene after tow was declined by Driver 2. Citation pending review of witness statements.
